title: VoiceMemberMoveEvent
description: VOICE_MEMBER_MOVE bus event (discordy.guild.v1, routed by guild_id). A moderator moved/disconnected a member or changed their stage speaker status. The gateway applies it to the live voice session and never dispatches it directly to clients.

channel_id.description: The voice channel to move the member to, or null to disconnect them.

suppress.description: Stage audience status: false promotes to speaker; true moves to audience.
